boundaries: The provider owns discardable bytes, manifest recovery and diagnostics only; it does not own canonical world state, asset selection, VSR leases, authority, promotion or commit.
Node filesystem rehydrate is locally verified; Browser Cache Storage/IndexedDB and Android app-private persistence are not implemented or proven.
The cache is bounded and rebuildable; multi-process or remote coherence, deployment-wide invalidation, format-aware prefetch, HLOD/PCG and large-world performance remain open.
Aether bridge regression is local Node evidence; it is not a real device, GPU, production deployment or commercial asset-format proof.
